يكتمنون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَمِنُونَ (yaktaminūna) /jak.ta.mi.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# يُكْتَمَنُونَ (yuktamanūna) /juk.ta.ma.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
